title: HOA Warfare: Call of Karen
notes: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. Web slice, Unity importer and tools/script_tools.mjs all read this file.

Line arrays are APPEND-ONLY. Line IDs are derived from array index (faction.event.c|s.index) and are used as VO file names. Never reorder or delete; mark retired lines with {"t": "...", "retired": true}.
A line is either a string or an object {t, alt?, flag?, retired?}. 'alt' is the legal-safe fallback used when legalSafeMode=true (default until counsel signs off). Record BOTH in the same VO session.
'clean' lines ship on both builds. 'steam' lines are Steam-only additions. If an event sets "steamMode": "replace", the Steam build uses ONLY the steam lines for that event.
1.8-second rule is linted at wordsPerSecond (shouted delivery). Final enforcement is on measured clip length.
